discovery: Discovery of glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) and its role as an incretin hormone, enabling GLP-1-based therapies for diabetes and obesity
rationale: GLP-1 biology has transformed treatment of type 2 diabetes and obesity, with large cardiovascular and renal outcome benefits; the trio already won the 2024 Lasker Clinical Award and the 2024 Breakthrough Prize, a common precursor pattern. After recent basic-science prizes (mRNA 2023, microRNA 2024, peripheral immune tolerance 2025), a high-impact translational metabolic discovery is well positioned.
